stem: The graph of \( f(x) = x^2 \) was transformed to create the graph of \( g(x) = f(x) - 9 \). Which statement about the graphs is true?

options.label: A
options.text: The graph of \( g \) is a reflection of the graph of \( f \) across the x-axis.

options.label: B
options.text: The vertex of the graph of \( g \) is 9 units to the right of the vertex of the graph of \( f \).

options.label: C
options.text: The graph of \( g \) is a reflection of the graph of \( f \) across the y-axis.

options.label: D
options.text: The y-intercept of the graph of \( g \) is 9 units below the y-intercept of the graph of \( f \).
